title: WebSocket synthetic monitoring — wsmon-probe
description: One target seen from the probes: health, latency, connection lifecycle and probe self-health, per entry point.

list.name: canonical
list.label: Canonical entry point
list.description: Entry point that carries real user traffic, e.g. the CDN. Used by the indicator, waterfall and vantage panels.

panels.title: Indicators — canonical path ($canonical · pingpong), over the dashboard range
Connection availability
panels.description: Share of time the connection was up.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time(wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Establishment success
panels.description: Share of connect attempts that succeeded. Reads 100% when there were no attempts.

targets.expr: 1 - sum(increase(wsmon_client_connect_failures_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(wsmon_client_connect_attempts_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Message delivery
panels.description: Share of sent messages echoed back before the deadline.

targets.expr: sum(increase(wsmon_client_messages_echoed_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="small"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(wsmon_client_messages_sent_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="small"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Latency ≤ 250 ms
panels.description: Share of round trips with RTT at or below 250 ms.

targets.expr: sum(increase(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="small", le="0.25"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_count{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="small"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Attribution — one row per entry point
panels.description: Health per entry point, outermost first. All rows degraded points to the server; otherwise the innermost degraded row is the faulty layer.

targets.expr: avg by (entrypoint) (avg_over_time(wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong"}[$__range]))

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_echoed_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__range])) / sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_sent_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__range])))

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_closes_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", close_code="1006"}[$__range])) or 0 * max by (entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"})
sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_lost_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__range]))
sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_connect_failures_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Connection up — pingpong and burst probes
panels.description: 1 while the probe's WebSocket connection is established.

targets.expr: max by (entrypoint, mode) (wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"})

panels.title: RTT p50 (t4 − t1)
panels.description: Median round-trip time, measured on the probe's clock.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: RTT p99 (t4 − t1)
panels.description: 99th percentile round-trip time, measured on the probe's clock.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Network RTT p50 (rtt − server time)
panels.description: Median RTT minus time spent in the echo server: network and proxy time only. Compare layers with this.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Network RTT p99 (rtt − server time)
panels.description: 99th percentile RTT minus time spent in the echo server: network and proxy time only.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Layer waterfall — $canonical minus pod_direct (network RTT)
panels.description: Network RTT the canonical entry point adds on top of connecting to the server pod directly.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, vantage) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval]))) - histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, vantage) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="pod_direct", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, vantage) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval]))) - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, vantage) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint="pod_direct", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Vantage comparison — $canonical network RTT p50, all vantages
panels.description: Median canonical network RTT from every vantage. Ignores the vantage selector.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, vantage) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_net_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", entrypoint="$canonical", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: RTT distribution — $entrypoint
panels.description: Distribution of round-trip times for the selected payload.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: RTT p99 by server replica
panels.description: p99 RTT per echo server replica. High for one replica on every entry point means that replica, not a layer.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint, server_name) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Server processing p99 (t3 − t2)
panels.description: Time the echo server takes to answer a probe. Should be flat and in microseconds.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_server_processing_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="pingpong"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Burst completion p99 (first send → last echo)
panels.description: Time from the first send to the last echo of a burst (20 messages every 10 s).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_burst_completion_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Burst RTT p99
panels.description: 99th percentile RTT of individual burst messages.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_rtt_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="burst", payload="$payload"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Abnormal closes (1006) by entry point
panels.description: Connections dropped without a close frame. The entry point where they appear identifies the component that dropped them.

targets.expr: sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_closes_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", close_code="1006"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Closes by code and initiator
panels.description: 1000 client = planned; 1001/1012 = server rollout; 1002 = protocol bug; 1009 = proxy frame limit; 1011 = server fault.

targets.expr: sum by (close_code, initiator, entrypoint, mode) (increase(wsmon_client_closes_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Connect failures by reason
panels.description: Failed connect attempts by reason: dns, tcp, tls, auth, http_status, upgrade_rejected, subprotocol, options_rejected, timeout.

targets.expr: sum by (reason, entrypoint, mode) (increase(wsmon_client_connect_failures_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Handshake phases p50 (since container start)
panels.description: Median time per handshake phase, over every connect since the probe started.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", phase="dns"}))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", phase="tcp"}))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", phase="tls"}))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", phase="upgrade"}))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connect_duration_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle", phase="hello"}))

panels.title: Connection age
panels.description: Time since the current connection was established. Drops to 0 on reconnect.

targets.expr: max by (mode, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connection_age_seconds{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"})

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Connections re-established after the previous one ended.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_reconnects_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Throughput and message integrity — pingpong and burst
Throughput — echoed messages per second
panels.description: Round trips completed per second. Should be flat (pingpong 1/s, burst 20 per 10 s); a dip means a stall or a drop.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, entrypoint) (rate(wsmon_client_messages_echoed_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Lost messages (no echo by deadline)
panels.description: Messages with no echo before the deadline, including those in flight at a disconnect.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, payload, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_lost_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Late echoes (after deadline)
panels.description: Echoes that arrived after the deadline.

targets.expr: sum by (mode, payload, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_late_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Contract anomalies (should be empty)
panels.description: Client/server protocol disagreements and clock steps. Should be empty.

targets.expr: sum by (field, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_mismatched_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_duplicate_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_out_of_order_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_messages_unexpected_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by (code, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_server_errors_received_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", code!="shutting_down"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
sum by (kind, entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_time_anomaly_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Idle timeouts — informational, not part of health
Effective idle timeout
panels.description: Longest idle period a connection fully survived over the range: the effective idle timeout of each path. 0 = no rung survived.

targets.expr:
max by (entrypoint) (
label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="30", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="30"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 30, "rung", "30", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="60", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="60"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 60, "rung", "60", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="90", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="90"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 90, "rung", "90", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="120", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="120"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 120, "rung", "120", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="300", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="300"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 300, "rung", "300", "", "")
  or label_replace((sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="600", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="600"}[$__range])) > 0) == bool 1) * 600, "rung", "600", "", "")
)

panels.title: Idle survival by rung (over the range)
panels.description: Share of idle connections that survived each rung. No bar means the rung was not reached.

targets.expr: sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="30", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="30"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="60", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="60"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="90", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="90"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="120", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="120"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="300", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="300"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="600", result="survived"}[$__range])) / (sum by (entrypoint) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", idle_bucket="600"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Idle drops — close code per rung
panels.description: How idle connections were dropped, per rung. none = no close frame, detected by echo timeout.

targets.expr: sum by (entrypoint, idle_bucket, close_code) (increase(wsmon_client_idle_probe_close_total{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Probe loop lag p99
panels.description: Scheduling delay of the probe's timers. Lag inflates measured latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, container) (rate(wsmon_client_loop_lag_seconds_bucket{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CPU periods the probe was throttled. Throttling inflates RTT. Empty when there is no CPU limit.

targets.expr:
sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
/ sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
* on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () count by (namespace, pod, container) (wsmon_client_build_info{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"})

panels.title: Clock offset to server (diagnostic)
panels.description: Estimated clock difference between probe and server. Diagnostic only; never used to correct measurements.

targets.expr: wsmon_client_clock_offset_seconds{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"}

panels.title: Probe containers — version, config hash, uptime
panels.description: Version, config hash and uptime per probe container. Different hashes on containers that should match mean config drift.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, name, version, go_version) (wsmon_client_build_info{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"})
max by (pod, container, hash) (wsmon_client_config_hash{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"})
time() - max by (pod, container) (wsmon_client_start_time_seconds{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint"})

max by (pod, container, mode, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode!="idle"}) or (2 + 0 * max by (pod, container, mode, entrypoint) (wsmon_client_connection_up{target=~"$target", vantage=~"$vantage", entrypoint=~"$entrypoint", mode="idle"}))
